column1: # Licence allowlist for client modules (core, data, sync, integrations, ui, app-android).
# `*` is a wildcard. Every resolved runtime dependency of a client module must match a
# row here, so a dependency that is not recorded fails `checkLicences`. The GPL family
# (GPL, LGPL, AGPL) is never allowed in the client (pr.md §12.4, Tech-Stack.md §16);
# Add a row with its real licence and the reason it is present. Do not widen a pattern
# to make a GPL-family dependency pass.
